parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of inconsistent handling of None in type hints by ensuring that 'None' is always linked to its documentation regardless of the autodoc_typehints setting.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by duplicating the logic for handling 'None' in both the record_typehints and modify_field_list functions. This could be refactored to avoid code duplication.
